info.title: ApexPost Logistics API
info.description: RESTful API for managing shipments and offline scan uploads. Responses use a nested recipient and the latest scan.

get.summary: Get a shipment by tracking number (partner API). Requires the X-Api-Key header.

post.summary:
Bulk upload offline scans (v1 and v2). Idempotent: scan IDs that are already stored are reported in
`duplicateScanIds` and skipped; scans that break a business rule are listed in
`rejectionDetails` with a reason. Requires the Courier role, and every scan must carry the
courierId of the caller's token.

get.summary: Get the scan history of a shipment, ordered by scan time (v2).
Get a paged list of shipments with nested recipient and latest scan (v2).
Get one shipment with nested recipient and latest scan (v2).

put.summary: Update the editable details of a shipment (v2). Only allowed while the status is Created.

delete.summary: Delete a shipment (v1 and v2). Only allowed while the status is Created. Requires the Admin role.

patch.summary:
Change the status of a shipment (v1 and v2). Allowed transitions:
Created → PickedUp → InTransit → OutForDelivery → Delivered, and Failed from any non-final state.
Requires the Courier role.

trackingNumber.description: Unique tracking number in format APX-NNNNNNNN.

recipientPhone.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format.

CreateShipmentRequest.description: Request to create a new shipment.

scanId.description: Unique scan ID from Part A offline store (format: scan::{Guid}).

courierId.description: Courier ID who performed the scan.

scannedAtUtc.description:
UTC timestamp when scan was performed. Business rules that depend on other data (not in the future,
not before the shipment was created, valid scan sequence) are applied per scan by the server and
reported in `rejectionDetails` instead of failing the whole batch.

notes.description: Notes about the scan (a Failed scan without a reason in the notes is rejected with a reason).

recipientSignature.description: Recipient signature name (a Delivered scan without one is rejected with a reason).

ScanDocumentRequest.description: Individual scan document from courier offline store.

scanId.description: The scan ID that was rejected.

ScanType.description: Scan type enumeration matching Part A.

scans.description: List of scan documents to upload.

ScanUploadRequest.description: Request to bulk upload offline scans from courier devices.

accepted.description: Number of scans successfully accepted and stored.

duplicatesSkipped.description: Number of scans skipped because they already existed (idempotent).

duplicateScanIds.description:
The scan IDs that were skipped as duplicates. Duplicates are not errors, so they are
listed here and never in List<ScanRejectionDetail> ScanUploadResponse.RejectionDetails.

rejected.description: Number of scans rejected with reasons.

rejectionDetails.description: Details for rejected scans (genuine rejections only, never duplicates).

ScanUploadResponse.description: Response for scan upload with counts.

ShipmentStatus.description: Shipment status enumeration matching the allowed transitions.

recipientPhone.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format.

UpdateShipmentRequest.description: Request to update an existing shipment's editable details.

reason.description: Optional reason for the status change (required for Delivered/Failed).

recipientSignature.description: Optional recipient signature name (required when status is Delivered).

UpdateStatusRequest.description: Request to update a shipment's status.

location.description: Location where the latest scan was performed.

scannedAtUtc.description: UTC timestamp when the latest scan was performed.

V2LatestScanSummary.description: Summary of the most recent scan for v2 responses.

items.description: List of items for the current page.

totalCount.description: Total number of items across all pages.

phone.description: Recipient phone number in E.164 format.

V2RecipientInfo.description: Nested recipient information for v2 responses.

scanId.description: Unique scan ID from Part A offline store (format: scan::{Guid}).

courierId.description: Courier ID who performed the scan.

scannedAtUtc.description: UTC timestamp when scan was performed.

recipientSignature.description: Optional recipient signature name (for Delivered scans).

V2ScanSummary.description: Scan summary for v2 responses with status as string enum.

trackingNumber.description: Unique tracking number in format APX-NNNNNNNN.

createdAtUtc.description: UTC timestamp when the shipment was created.

updatedAtUtc.description: UTC timestamp when the shipment was last updated.

V2ShipmentDetail.description: v2 Shipment detail response with nested recipient and latest scan summary.

trackingNumber.description: Unique tracking number in format APX-NNNNNNNN.

createdAtUtc.description: UTC timestamp when the shipment was created.

lastScanAtUtc.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent scan.

scanCount.description: Total number of scans for this shipment.

V2ShipmentSummary.description: v2 Shipment summary for list responses with status as string enum.

Bearer.description: JWT access token. In Development get one from POST /dev/token.

ApiKey.description: Partner API key for the read-only partner endpoints.
